_doc: Every account-specific value lives here. Copy to config/deployment.json and fill in. Nothing else in the repo hardcodes these.

site.title: Macro Monitor
site.footer: Macro Monitor, built with Claude Code

pages._doc: Where the static site is published. tools.publish_pages mirrors docs/<slug>/ into <repo>/<dir>/<slug>/ and commits; the skill pushes it to <branch>. Pages serves <repo>/<dir>/ at the site's host.

secrets._doc: Names only. All are optional: BLS and FRED CSV work keyless. FRED_API_KEY adds the official FRED release calendar; BLS_API_KEY raises the BLS rate limit.
